newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile's El Tesoro copper mine awaits environmental okay.
newsitem.headline: Chile's El Tesoro copper mine awaits environmental okay.

text.p: Chile's El Tesoro copper mine has handed over to authorities its environmental impact study for the 60,000 tonne pit the company is planning to build in northern Chile.
The project will involve an investment of $230 million and should come into production in late 1998, according to a notice published in the government gazette Diario Oficial.
The mine, which is owned by Australia's Equatorial Mining and Chile's Luksic group, will produce copper cathodes using low-cost heap-leaching technology.
Local environment authorities have six months to approve the study which is part of a public consultation process over the project.
